employee_name.description: The full name of the employee

name: generate_onboarding_checklist
description: The script will return a JSON object in `result.data`. This object contains an `employee` key (a string) and a `checklist` key (an array of objects).
Your response MUST follow this format:
1.  Start by addressing the employee: "Here is the onboarding checklist for [Employee Name]:"
3.  Present the checklist as a clean, bulleted list.
4.  For each item, format it as: "**[due_date]**: [task] ([status])"
